angri-expressions.title: Ang-ri - Expression Set
angri-expressions.caption: The full dialogue sprite set for the player character. Every expression is keyed off one base pose so the set stays visually consistent and cheap to extend when new story beats need new emotions.

yuli-expressions.title: Yuli - Expression Set
yuli-expressions.caption: Matching dialogue sprite set for Yuli. Built to the same base-pose rule as Ang-ri's so the two characters sit together on screen without one reading as drawn later or by someone else.

works.title: The Deep Dark - Key Art
works.caption: Promotional key art for Chapter 1. Pure black-and-white rendering keeps the read legible at thumbnail size while establishing the chapter's claustrophobic, lightless tone.

works.title: Coelacanth - Title Treatment
works.caption: Early title card and logotype study. Hand-lettered type paired with anglerfish and skeletal motifs to set the indie-horror register before a single line of dialogue.

works.title: Ang-ri - Portrait HUD & Health Bar
works.caption: In-game HUD mockup: character bust framed by a bone cartouche with heart-pip health. Designed so the frame art survives cropping to a 1:1 UI slot.

works.title: Ang-ri - Character Sheet (V1, scrapped)
works.caption: A full-body pass that was ultimately cut. Kept in the portfolio deliberately: the bioluminescent lure, fin-ears and tail silhouette all survived into the final design.

works.title: Main Cast - Ensemble Sketches
works.caption: Exploratory pass on the core trio. Silhouette and proportion are varied first so each character reads distinctly before any rendering is committed.

works.title: Ang-ri - First Sprite Pass
works.caption: The earliest rendered sprite, kept as a reference point for how far the design has moved.

works.title: Robed Figure - Concept Sketch
works.caption: Construction sketch for a court character. Drapery and ribbon flow are blocked in loosely to test how the silhouette moves underwater.

works.title: Idle
works.caption: Neutral dialogue sprite. The base pose every other expression is keyed from.

works.title: Joy
works.caption: Brow and lure position carry the emotion so the body art stays reusable.

works.title: Downcast
works.caption: Written for the Chapter 1 loss beat.

works.title: Outline Test
works.caption: Outline-free variant, tested for readability against dark underwater backgrounds.

works.title: Idle
works.caption: Neutral dialogue sprite for Ang-ri's adopted sister.

works.title: Happy
works.caption: Expression variant.

works.title: Sigh
works.caption: Expression variant.

works.title: Outline Test
works.caption: Outline-free variant for background-contrast testing.

works.title: Sky Guardian
works.caption: Fan art rendered at full illustration scale. Layered feather, cloud and fur forms keep a very large silhouette readable against a bright, low-contrast sky - the hardest part of the piece was stopping the creature from dissolving into its background.

works.title: Lily Pond
works.caption: Two characters staged in a fully painted environment. Depth is carried by water clarity and cast shadow rather than atmospheric haze, so the foreground stays fully saturated.

works.title: Blossom Valley
works.caption: Companion piece in a warmer key. A backlit cherry canopy and low horizon push both characters forward as the focal read.

works.title: Sotto - Crowned
works.caption: Painterly figure study. Scale is built entirely through relation - a small body cradled in oversized hands beneath a severed face. The crop of this piece is what I use as my avatar.

works.title: Rabbit Room
works.caption: Fan art of a character by the artist skineor. Horror composition in a restricted red and black key - the duplicated figure and encroaching hands build the threat without ever showing what is doing it.

works.title: Reliquary
works.caption: Fan art for the band Ghost. Flat primary blocking against painted stained glass, pushing how far a palette can be reduced before form stops reading.

works.title: Sotto - Offering
works.caption: Seasonal illustration mixing a rendered portrait with an inset chibi - a deliberate test of two rendering registers inside one frame.

works.title: Sotto - Pixel Heart
works.caption: Anatomical framing with an intentionally low-resolution heart. The resolution clash is the subject rather than an artefact.

works.title: Still Season
works.caption: A quieter register: soft-edged rendering, patterned flats and a high-key palette, built to contrast the darker work in this section.

works.title: Sotto - Grin
works.caption: Sticker-style character bust. A hard white keyline and torn red field make the piece work as a standalone cut-out asset.

works.title: Sotto - Reference Sheet
works.caption: Working reference sheet for Sotto: a rendered bust paired with a chibi full-body and margin notes, formatted the way a sheet gets handed to a collaborator.

works.title: Qanata - Acrylic Keychain Pair
works.caption: Commissioned merchandise for a school event. Drawn to a keychain cut-line with a bleed outline, hole placement and a branded colourway per character.

works.title: Tiwi - Acrylic Keychain
works.caption: Second design in the same run. A softer palette and grass base vary the silhouette across the set.
